summary.en: Use any OpenAI Responses WebSocket relay (codex-proxy-rs or a compatible gateway) from magpie: one frame per event is translated to SSE, and a per-provider switch falls back to the relay's plain HTTP/SSE. Unlike an ordinary custom provider, this one speaks the WebSocket Upgrade path without changing magpie.
summary.zh: 让 magpie 接入支持官方 Responses WebSocket 的中转站（codex-proxy-rs 或兼容网关）：逐帧翻译成 SSE，供应商页开关可随时退回 HTTP/SSE。与普通自定义供应商不同，它走的是 WebSocket Upgrade 路径，且不修改 magpie 本体。
